name: Understanding a Problem
purpose: A visual aid to accurately decompose and frame the key attributes of a busi- ness problem.
whereUsed: The Understanding a Problem is best used in the Problem Space during the Analysis Phase (2.1) to “Pinpoint Core Business Problems.” It’s also useful in the Solution Space to illustrate the complexity of business problems.
why: We will frame and address root cause problems, as opposed to solving for generic issues that result in limited worth to the business.
outcomes: A thorough understanding of the problem being confronted
Decision to pursue or stop pursuit of a solution to solve a problem
Agreement to the importance of addressing a business problem

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Review major elements to consider and understand when framing a business problem
Confirm understanding and agreement to business problems worth solving
Compare similarities and differences among business problems
Document possible gaps to resolving problems

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Illustrate how previous business problems have been framed
Confirm a complete understanding of the business problem the solution addresses
Challenge assumptions among stakeholders about a potential business problem
Brainstorm potential alternatives to already considered solutions
List key takeaways (gaps, risks, actions, etc.)
